architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events via SVC-102 (Event Bus). Within a capability, services may communicate synchronously. No capability ever calls another capability's API directly.

consumed_events.name: AccountDetailsConfirmed
consumed_events.purpose: Event-driven response to SVC-009's account validation request at PH-047. SVC-001 confirms that the account_id / sort code / account number combination is active and eligible for Direct Debits. Used instead of a synchronous cross-capability API call.

consumed_events.name: AccountDebited (re-used from JRN-002, EVT-184 pattern)
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-001 publishes AccountDebited after successfully debiting the customer account at D-0 (PH-050). SVC-009 consumes this to update DirectDebitCollection.status = collected and publish EVT-072.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInsufficientFunds
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-001 publishes this when the D-0 balance check fails (account balance < collection amount). SVC-009 consumes this to initiate ARUDD return, update DirectDebitCollection.status = returned, and publish EVT-073.

consumed_events.name: AccountCredited
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-001 publishes AccountCredited after processing the indemnity credit triggered by EVT-074 (DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled). SVC-009 consumes this to confirm the claim has been processed and initiates the BACS indemnity recovery from the originator.

api_endpoints_exposed: GET /v1/direct-debits — list active DDIs for an account
GET /v1/direct-debits/{ddi_id}/collections — list collections for a DDI
POST /v1/direct-debits/{ddi_id}/indemnity-claim — file an indemnity claim (DD Guarantee)
scheme_interactions: AUDDIS 0N — new DDI submission to BACS via Vocalink at PH-047
AUDDIS 0C — DDI cancellation submission to BACS
BACS collection file receipt — originator collection instructions received at D-2 (PH-049)
ARUDD — automated return of unpaid Direct Debit at D-0 (PH-050, exception path)
BACS INDEMNITY claim — recovery from originator after DD Guarantee credit (PH-051)

design_decisions.decision: SVC-009 does not call SVC-001 directly for balance checks or account debits. All cross-capability coordination uses async events on SVC-102.
design_decisions.rationale: Architecture principle: cross-capability calls are exclusively async events. SVC-009 (CAP-003) and SVC-001 (CAP-001) are in different capability domains. Synchronous call would introduce tight coupling and violate the capability boundary model.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-009 exposes the Direct Debit API endpoints as part of the CAP-003 Payment Operations API contract (payment-operations.openapi.json), not as a separate SVC-009-specific API.
design_decisions.rationale: API contracts are per-capability. The channel interacts with the capability boundary, not individual services.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionCreated
consumed_events.purpose: Records new DDI against account for account management display.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionValidated
consumed_events.purpose: Updates account management state — DDI now active and visible in customer dashboard.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: Surfaces upcoming Direct Debit collection in customer's upcoming transactions view at D-2.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled
consumed_events.purpose: CRITICAL — triggers immediate account credit under the DD Guarantee. SVC-001 credits claimed_amount to account_id and publishes AccountCredited. Must process within < 30 seconds (DD Guarantee 'immediate' obligation). Idempotent on claim_id.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-001's consumer group for the payments.direct-debit topic is configured with high-priority, low-latency processing to meet the DD Guarantee immediate credit obligation on EVT-074.
design_decisions.rationale: The Direct Debit Guarantee requires the bank to credit the customer's account immediately on an indemnity claim. This is a regulatory obligation (not a best-effort SLA). The async event architecture must meet this obligation via low-latency consumer configuration.

design_decisions.decision: All JRN-012 events use the topic payments.direct-debit, partitioned by account_id. This ensures strict ordering of all DDI and collection events for a given account.
design_decisions.rationale: BACS lifecycle events (DDI creation → validation → collection → indemnity) must be strictly ordered per account. Partitioning by account_id guarantees this. Separate topic from retail.payments (FPS/CHAPS) to allow independent scaling and monitoring.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionCreated
consumed_events.purpose: Sends DDI setup acknowledgement notification for originator-initiated mandates.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionValidated
consumed_events.purpose: Sends DDI active confirmation with Direct Debit Guarantee summary.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: Sends advance notice notification: amount, collection date, originator name.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionProcessed
consumed_events.purpose: Sends post-collection confirmation notification.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionReturned
consumed_events.purpose: Sends unpaid Direct Debit notification with customer-friendly explanation and next steps.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled
consumed_events.purpose: Sends indemnity confirmation after AccountCredited event received: credited amount, mandate cancellation status.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionCreated
consumed_events.purpose: WORM audit record.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionValidated
consumed_events.purpose: WORM audit record.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: WORM audit record.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionProcessed
consumed_events.purpose: WORM audit record.

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionReturned

consumed_events.name: DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: SVC-009 triggers account debit on D-0 via event; SVC-001 processes debit and publishes AccountDebited back via event bus. For indemnity claims, SVC-009 publishes EVT-074 and SVC-001 credits immediately.
SVC-001 publishes outcome events back to SVC-009 after processing debit requests and indemnity credits.

Channel calls CAP-003 Payment Operations API for DDI setup, list, cancellation, and indemnity claims. Persona → Channel → CAP-003 API pattern strictly followed. Channel never calls SVC-009 directly — it calls the capability API endpoint.
